args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    COUNT(sm.facetregistry) AS total_mesh_count,
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) AS high_fidelity_mesh_count,
    (SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END) * 100.0 / COUNT(sm.facetregistry)) AS high_fidelity_proportion,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_geometric_accuracy,
    AVG(sm.facetresmm) AS avg_resolution_params,
    AVG(sm.geomdeltamm) AS avg_complexity_ratio,
    sm.uvmapqual AS mesh_quality
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
GROUP BY 
    s.zonelabel, sm.uvmapqual
ORDER BY 
    high_fidelity_proportion DESC;
